selection_rule: Post-hoc development diagnostic of the only incomplete P25 case; no selection claim or confirmation test.
server_lease_basis: Unchanged M3 server; at least 2160 live seconds required before the one task.
scope: One known development case, one seed. API request ceiling 80 to 160; all other inference and tool conditions fixed. Not a proposed method.
discovery_policy: Initially api_docs and supervisor schemas. A requested app description exposes that public app; individual API documentation exposes that API. New schemas apply on the next model response. No answer-based selection or silent top-k pruning.
interpretation: Only the API ceiling differs from P25; no automatic increase or retry after failure.
Compare actual request/action/observation prefixes; a fixed seed does not guarantee identical prefixes.
The observed individual-action cost is not a lower bound over all public API strategies.
history_representation: Append-only public assistant content/calls and tool observations; no reasoning replay. Same archive page size. Invalid argument turns use text fallback preserving raw calls and actual results.
